recipe.visualDefinition: A low-angle, wide-perspective shot of a male figure in streetwear seated in a narrow, dimly lit European-style stone alleyway, featuring a foreground collage of distressed paper and currency with integrated illustrative typography.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject centered between converging vertical lines of alley walls
Foreground paper collage acting as a visual base for the subject
Contrast between the cool-toned background and warm-toned foreground paper
Symmetry established by the archway and flanking walls
coreInvariants: Narrow alleyway setting with stone textures
Distressed paper/currency collage in the immediate foreground
Green pinstripe-style ornamental border at the bottom

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central mid-ground, medium-full shot, scaled to dominate the vertical center of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, distressed paper bundle in the bottom foreground.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eye starts at the foreground paper, moves up to the subject's face, then follows the alleyway depth into the background arch.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Dark, shadowed areas of the alley walls and the upper night sky provide breathing room for the central action.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Desaturated earth tones and stone grays in the environment.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep blacks in shadows and the subject's clothing.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant lime green for the bottom ornamental banner and warm sepia for the foreground paper.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High contrast with deep shadows; saturation is concentrated in the foreground graphic elements.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Heavy, distressed sans-serif and condensed block lettering.
letterConstructionRules: Foreground text appears hand-painted or stenciled onto wrinkled paper
Sub-title text uses a clean, ultra-condensed sans-serif with vertical elongation
Inclusion of decorative '+' symbols as spacers
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters on paper have irregular edges and internal texture mimicking ink on rough surfaces
The 'O' in the main name is oversized and slightly tilted
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Distressed, organic hand-lettering paired with rigid, geometric condensed sans-serif.

preserve: The contrast between the messy foreground text and the clean banner text

candidateDirections.reason: For the main display text on the paper

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A low-angle photo of a man in a grey t-shirt and sunglasses sitting in a narrow stone alleyway at night. In the foreground, place a large pile of wrinkled brown paper and currency. Use a wide-angle lens to emphasize the depth of the alley and the archway behind him.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply a dark, hand-painted style name onto the foreground paper. Add a lime green ornamental pinstripe banner at the very bottom containing a white, ultra-condensed sans-serif subtitle.

verificationChecks: Is the green banner at the bottom present?
Does the foreground text look like it is part of the paper texture?

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the green flourishes are symmetrical
Check that the foreground paper looks physically present in the scene
Confirm the subtitle is legible within the banner
recipe.reuseFormula: Urban Alleyway + Low Angle + Foreground Paper Collage + Distressed Display Type + Ornamental Bottom Banner
